title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E18 — The General's Lady
When a scout from the Battle of the Little Big Horn tries to blackmail Gen. Custer's widow, she fears he plans to provide damaging testimony at an upcoming hearing for Maj. Reno; Earp must convince her that her husband was a courageous man.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E19 — The Manly Art
Unscrupulous businessman Moresby, seeking a way to permanently cripple Earp, convinces a boxing promoter to have his champ beat Earp, but the marshal refuses to take up the challenge until the champ's blatant cheating injures a young man in the ring.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E20 — Sweet Revenge
Earp begins dating Mrs. Phillips, a widowed seamstress, but fears for her safety as word arrives in Dodge City that a convict Earp helped put away has escaped and wants revenge.

title: The Third Man
description: Visiting postwar Vienna, a writer (Joseph Cotten) of pulp Westerns probes the suspicious death of an old friend (Orson Welles).

title: In a Lonely Place
description: A bungalow neighbor (Gloria Grahame) alibis a boozing Hollywood screenwriter (Humphrey Bogart) accused of murder.

title: Munster, Go Home
description: Herman (Fred Gwynne), Lily (Yvonne De Carlo), Grandpa (Al Lewis) and their ghoulish TV family go to England to claim an estate.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: Wild Stallion
description: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse.

title: The Mob
description: An undercover officer (Broderick Crawford) tracks waterfront corruption from California to New Orleans and back.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: State of the Union
description: An heiress (Angela Lansbury) wants a self-made man (Spencer Tracy) to run for president with his estranged wife (Katharine Hepburn) by his side.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E21 — The Imitation Jesse James
Earp arrests a stagecoach robber who copies the style of Jesse James, but the witnesses refuse to testify, and the robber goes free, leading Earp to enlist the skill of a cheating gambler to set a trap for him.

title: Stranger From Arizona
description: A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E22 — The Kansas Lily
A former Confederate spy asks Earp and Bat to help her escape from her dead brother's gang; Bat develops feelings for the woman, but Earp, doubting her story, obeys a warrant calling for her arrest.

title: Beauty and the Bandit
description: The Cisco Kid (Gilbert Roland) and Chico (Martin Garralaga) secure the deed to a woman's ranch.

title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S01 E31 — Hunt the Man Down
Earp must enter the rough Bushwhacker region to find a man suspected of murder, but his behavior once found leads Earp to believe the man is not guilty of the crime.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S01 E33 — Bat Masterson Again
Earp tries to help an old friend, Bat Masterson, who is working as an Army scout and being threatened by a killer.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E01 — Wichita Is Civilized
Earp must defuse a conflict between warring families after Ollie and Mildred Taylor set up shop in Wichita and become targets of a man angry at Ollie's cousin for killing his brother; tensions escalate into a deadly struggle, then a lynch mob.
